fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded truck entrance at the SW/south property line: Street View (pano mlac-CAWOgXfcDblQC8HTQ, 2012-09) and z19 satellite both show a gatehouse canopy straddling the inbound lane with a tractor-trailer queued at it, yellow lane markings, and perimeter chain-link fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A staffed booth with a flat canopy roof spanning the entry lane is clearly visible in Street View beside the gate and as a small structure on the road at z19 satellite (~39.8843,-77.6777). Distinct from the larger office/amenity building just north of it.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a manned guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ — the long west building face shows continuous dock doors with dozens of trailers backed in; an RDC of ~1.3M sq ft. ~120 is an honest estimate, low precision.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ — extensive west/north-side trailer drop yards with hundreds of parked trailers in marked rows.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear concentrated on the single west building face; east face (toward I-81) has no docks. Marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and multiple lanes at the gate with room for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (Rita Tech Park) along I-81 outside Chambersburg, surrounded by farmland — Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron and internal yard immediately inside the gate before the docks.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the west property edge (Archer Dr corridor) but no spur appears to enter the property; railServed=false.
